evidence: Figure 2 shows scanning electron microscope (SEM) images and the corresponding elemental maps measured for Sample 2, indicating the presence of a conformal Al 2O3 coating on the fibers. According to X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) measurement (depth profile shown in Fig. 3), the Al 2O3 coating was stoichiometric. The X-ray diffraction (XRD) image of the coated fiber matrix (Fig. 6) shows the (111) reflection of cubic Ir, thus confirming the presence of metallic Ir. The electrochemical corrosion analysis was performed measuring corrosion current in an electrolyte comprising 0.1 N H2SO4 in 90% ethanol. Thermal oxidation tests were performed with the fiber matrices being subject to a heat treatment (500 8C for 12 h in air). The BSE images were acquired with a Hitachi S-4800 field emission SEM.
